title: The Obsession Begins
narration: Three roads. One obsession. Somewhere right now, a kid is staring at a car they can't afford — and feeling something they don't have words for yet.

title: Drawing in Margins
narration: At school you fill the margins of your notebooks with cars. Side profiles mostly. The proportions are wrong at first — but you practice, and they get better.

title: Three Garages
narration: One of you is in a concrete garage with a rusty hatchback. One has magazines in a wooden crate. One is watching a man talk about Jaguar suspension at a Sunday car show.

title: The Starting Point
narration: The tuner: sixteen years old. A 1995 Honda Civic with rust and a rattling exhaust. To everyone else, it's a problem. To you, it's a starting point.

title: Title Moment
narration: This is your life — at every rank — as a mechanic, a tuner, and a collector. Every rank changes you.

title: Shop Porter
narration: Level one. The mechanic: you're a shop porter. You move cars, sweep floors, and watch the real technicians work. You don't touch anything important yet.

title: Watching Everything
narration: But you watch everything. Every movement. Every tool. Every decision. You're learning before you're allowed to learn.

title: Learning from YouTube
narration: The tuner: you watch YouTube on a laptop propped on a step stool. You pause. You go do the thing. You come back and rewind because you did it wrong.

title: First Mod
narration: Your first mod is a cold air intake. Three weekends researching. One afternoon installing. The sound changes immediately. At sixteen, that matters enormously.

title: The Dreamer
narration: The collector: you're twelve. A Ferrari F40 poster on your ceiling. You know it has no radio, no air conditioning, no carpet — because Ferrari stripped everything to save weight.

title: The E-Type Conversation
narration: At fourteen, a man with a restored E-Type talks to you for forty-five minutes about independent rear suspension. You go home and write down everything you can remember.

title: First Car
narration: Level two. The collector: your first car is a Volkswagen Golf. Faded paint. Rust at the sills. Nine hundred euros. You love it because it's yours.

title: Lube Tech
narration: The mechanic: you're a lube tech now. Oil changes. Tire rotations. Multi-point inspections. The pace is fast. The margin for error is supposed to be zero.

title: Hands Inside
narration: You replace brake pads and understand for the first time how a braking system actually functions — by having your hands inside one.

title: Lowering Springs
narration: The tuner: lowering springs. The first time without proper tools, it nearly takes your hand off. You borrow a compressor from a neighbor and follow the process with extreme caution.

title: Car Meet
narration: Level three. The tuner: car meets. A parking lot on Sunday evenings. You show up feeling like everyone knows each other — and you know nobody.

title: The Alfa GTV
narration: The collector: an Alfa Romeo GTV from a man in northern Italy. One hundred sixty thousand kilometers — with documentation for every single one.

title: The Community
narration: You join clubs. You meet people who've been doing this for thirty years. Car collecting is not a solo activity. The knowledge lives in the community.

title: The Eclipse GSX
narration: Level four. The tuner: the Civic is gone. A Mitsubishi Eclipse GSX. All-wheel drive. Turbocharged from the factory. A platform with a real ceiling.

title: System Thinking
narration: Every modification has a reason now. Turbo upgraded. Fuel system upgraded. Intercooler upgraded. Every change connects to the next one.

title: Porsche 911T
narration: The collector: a 1972 Porsche 911 T. Matching numbers. Factory certificate. You drive it on a mountain road in autumn and understand why people call certain cars alive.

title: Research Before Buying
narration: You research before you buy now. Factory option codes. Dating certificates. You know what correct matching numbers looks like — and what it costs to confuse them.

title: First Diagnostic Win
narration: The mechanic: your first real diagnostic win. A vacuum leak so small it took three technicians to miss. Diagnosing is a separate skill from building.

title: The Subaru Fix
narration: Level five. The tuner: a friend's Subaru tuned by three different people — still rough under boost. You spend a Saturday and find a vacuum leak they all missed.

title: 500 Horsepower
narration: Your build hits five hundred horsepower at the wheels on a platform not designed for it. A Japanese car culture magazine features it. Forty-seven messages from around the world.

title: Cars with Stories
narration: The collector: a Fiat 131 Abarth that competed in period rallies. A Lancia Fulvia that belonged to a racing journalist. Evidence of lives that no longer exist.

title: Pre-Purchase Inspection
narration: Friends ask you to look at a car before they buy. You go. You check what they don't know to check. You save some of them from expensive mistakes.

title: ASE Certified
narration: The mechanic: ASE certifications on the wall. Electrical gremlins. Intermittent faults. You're not a professional in title — but you're not an amateur anymore.

title: Coach-Built Focus
narration: Level six. The collector: Italian coach-built cars. Zagato. Pininfarina. Bertone. Craftsmen who no longer exist. Techniques that no longer exist.

title: The Inner Circle
narration: The community at this level is forty or fifty people worldwide who share your focus. You know most of them. Reputation is the primary currency.

title: Professional Tuner
narration: The tuner: you're doing this for money now. A laptop with seven ECU tuning platforms. A waiting list three weeks long. When it's their car and their money, the standards are absolute.

title: Lines Worth Holding
narration: Some builds are genuinely dangerous. You've seen enough engines destroyed by bad decisions. There are lines worth holding — even when someone is upset about it.

title: Lab Scope First
narration: The mechanic: lab scope first. Wiring diagrams before parts. You teach younger techs that a pending code is information — not noise.

title: The Collection
narration: Level seven. The collector: fifteen cars across two climate-controlled facilities. Each documented. Each insured. Each driven at least once per year.

title: Pebble Beach Judge
narration: You've judged at Pebble Beach. Written catalog notes for Bonhams. The community recognizes your opinion carries weight — and you treat that as a responsibility.

title: Teaching Workshops
narration: The tuner: three bays. Two lifts. Your own dyno. You teach workshops. The knowledge that took fifteen years now moves faster through others.

title: Shop Foreman
narration: The mechanic: shop foreman. You manage the floor and mentor the young techs. Your judgment is your reputation — and your reputation is your access.

title: World Record
narration: Level eight. The tuner: a Nissan Skyline built for a world record. The first attempt fails. You fix a fuel delivery issue that evening. The second day, the record falls.

title: Best in Class
narration: The collector: a car you researched wins Best in Class at Pebble Beach. The research was yours. The case for its significance was yours.

title: Your Shop
narration: The mechanic: your shop. Your name on the door. Eleven technicians trained who now run their own practices. You still turn wrenches on the jobs that matter.

title: The Legend Drives
narration: Level nine. The legend. You still drive your cars. Not for the public. Not for photos. Because the relationship between a driver and a car is what this was always about.

title: The Loop
narration: Somewhere right now, a kid has a poster on their ceiling. They'll figure it out. Most do. Some will go further. That's how it's supposed to work.
